basis: Developmental delay, severe intellectual disability and skeletal hand/foot anomalies define the syndrome; cardiac and urinary malformations lack established frequency.
Inherited trimethylamine metabolism defect; odor does not establish skin damage, and emotional symptoms do not establish neurologic injury.
Ovarian carcinoma has reproductive-organ origin; neuroendocrine morphology alone does not establish endocrine dysfunction across the group.
Maternal alloantibodies destroy fetal platelets; intracranial hemorrhage affects a minority, below 30%.
Autoinflammatory vasculitis with progressive pulmonary inflammation/fibrosis; cutaneous vasculitis is a defining criterion, placed in involved because primary is capped at three.
Hepatic glycogen metabolism disorder with hepatomegaly in 10/15 and biochemical liver injury; reduced erythrocyte enzyme activity does not establish blood-cell damage.
Inherited epithelial dyskeratosis defined by persistent conjunctival and oral mucosal plaques; oral mucosa belongs to gastrointestinal.
Cerebellar dysfunction and sensorineural hearing loss define the syndrome; pes cavus has no established common frequency.
Disorder of adipose tissue loss or redistribution, classified as cutaneous and metabolic; systemic complications are not shared across localized and generalized forms.
Severe congenital neutropenia causes a blood-cell deficiency and impaired innate immunity; eosinophilia is also hematologic.
Psychiatric disorder of intentionally produced symptoms; no particular organ injury defines the condition.
Nontraumatic atlantoaxial subluxation involving cervical joints and ligaments; preceding ENT infection does not make the subluxation itself an infection.
Unbalanced transfusion through placental vascular anastomoses defines the disorder; fetal blood-volume imbalance supports vascular and blood axes, without an immune mechanism.
Tumor originates in odontogenic epithelium; approximately 95% are intraosseous jaw tumors with bone occupation and local destruction.
Mesothelial tumor arising in the pleura, which belongs to the pulmonary axis.
Autoimmune disease with characteristic skin lesions; ILD affects roughly 60-90%, often severely. Muscle injury varies and is frequently absent in amyopathic cases.
Odontogenic epithelial tumor; approximately 90-95% grow within jaw bone, causing direct occupation and local invasion. Skin ancestry conflicts with the definition.
Congenital capillary malformations are vascular lesions, predominantly located in skin; visceral disease is not shared across the umbrella.
Cerebellar degeneration and ataxia define SCA42; dysphagia, urgency and abnormal eye movements reflect neurologic dysfunction rather than separate organ damage.
Malignant precursor lymphocytes define a hematologic neoplasm; the umbrella includes lymphoblastic lymphoma, supporting the immune mechanism axis.
Primary skeletal muscle dystrophy; disabling retinal disease, clinically significant hearing loss and respiratory failure affect minorities, generally below 30%.
Medulloblastoma is a primary cerebellar CNS tumor; large-cell morphology does not change its organ of origin.
Progressive lymphoid-system deterioration indicates immunodeficiency; the sparse record does not establish specific blood-cell abnormalities or other organ damage.
HGSNAT-related isolated retinal dystrophy with retinal atrophy in 6/6; the gene association alone does not establish systemic storage disease.
Opportunistic fungal infection with variable cutaneous, pulmonary or disseminated sites; the supplied definition establishes no individual organ involvement at 30% or more.
